verdict.rationale: Omnara documents choosing among models from OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Bedrock, or self-hosted endpoints, with an organization configuring a model and granting it to a project before agents use it. That implies explicit model choice, but nothing shows an automatic model-selection mode or a way to switch from one to a pinned model. Missing for 10: evidence of an automatic model-selection mode, a documented way to override it with a specific model per agent, explicit agent-config model field documentation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can switch away from automatic model selection to a specific model of my choice

citations.quote: Use models from OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, or Amazon Bedrock, or connect a compatible model you host yourself.
Before an agent can use a model, your organization connects the provider, configures the model, and grants it to the project
custom model endpoints in the dashboard
